inputs.question: Does this grading plan show both existing and proposed grade lines (contours)? Look for contour lines showing both existing conditions and proposed grading, with labels distinguishing between existing and proposed contours.
inputs.reasoning: The agent is asking whether contour lines and their labels are present and distinguishable on the grading plan drawing itself—a visual inspection of drawing elements (lines, labels, spatial relationships) rather than a presence/absence check or measurement task.
